Agent Name: Orchestrator (termination condition)
Step Number: 49
Reason for Mistake: The termination step fabricated the final answer by providing a GDV genome browser page instead of a direct GFF3 download link and did not verify the “most recent as of 20/10/2020” criterion. This is the first irrecoverable action because it ends the process with an incorrect URL, preventing any correction. Earlier misnavigations were recoverable, but this step directly produced the wrong result.
